identification.prompt: Examine the attached image carefully. Is a bird visible? If so, identify which bird and species it is from visible features, giving its common name and scientific name only when supported by the image. Do not assume a bird is present or infer a species from the feeder or background. If blur, occlusion, or image quality prevents deciding whether a bird is present, use inconclusive rather than empty. Return ONLY a JSON object with status (empty, identified, inconclusive), common_name (string or null), name (Latin binomial or null), category (bird or unknown), confidence (0 to 1), and notes. Identify birds only; no bird means empty. For identified use category bird. If a bird is visible but its species is uncertain, use common_name "Unidentified bird" and name null; never invent a scientific name. For empty/inconclusive use null names, category unknown and confidence 0.
